story: Calibration comparison across market TYPES. Moneyline/game-winner corpora carry resolved outcomes -> model and market Brier scored per type. The rescued in-game TOTALS quote-tracks carry NO resolved outcome -> disclosed as unscorable (n + model-vs-market divergence only), never a fabricated Brier.
floors: labeled market type needs n>=30 usable rows for a Brier/ECE; ECE=n-weighted |mean_p-mean_y| over 10 bins; mlb_clean byte-dup excluded; edge_claimed=False

soccer_match.description: soccer in-game match result (2-way, as graded)

mlb_total.description: MLB in-game over/under run total (Kalshi KXMLBTOTAL quote-tracks)
mlb_total.reason: no resolved outcome label on rescued live quote-tracks (settlement join unavailable)

model_vs_market_divergence.note: abs(model_prob - market_prob) per tick -- a calibration-GAP MEASUREMENT, not an edge

mlb_total.brier_disclosure: Brier is NULL by design: these rows have no resolved outcome; scoring would require fabricating labels.

skipped.reason: mlb_clean is a byte-identical duplicate of mlb -- excluded to avoid double counting

verdict: Brier scored only for market types whose corpora carry resolved outcomes: mlb_moneyline: model Brier 0.2377 vs market 0.2067 (n=78986); soccer_match: model Brier 0.2279 vs market 0.1427 (n=9003). Unscorable market types (no resolved outcome, disclosed not fabricated): mlb_total.
